Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-10-13

1. Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
Google announced that its newest frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, is now available to a wide range of users—including developers, enterprises, scientists, and everyday consumers.

2. Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
Asana used GPT-6 Astra in Codex to optimize a browser-agent workflow running on GPT-6.1 Sol. In its tests, the optimized workflow was 76 times cheaper and five times faster than its original production setup.

3. Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
Pollo AI combines GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-Image-2.5 to help creators develop storylines, images and video ads through a guided workflow.
